tasks.label: compose-up-db
tasks.command: bash -lc 'if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose up -d db; else echo "docker is not available in this dev container. Run this task in a Docker-capable environment or mount a Docker socket before launching the debug configuration." >&2; exit 127; fi'

tasks.label: compose-up-stack
tasks.command: bash -lc 'if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose up --build; else echo "docker is not available in this dev container. Run this task in a Docker-capable environment or mount a Docker socket before starting the Compose stack." >&2; exit 127; fi'
